meta.title: Frankencoin referral program: earn up to 25% of savers' interest
meta.description: Wallets, communities and creators can set themselves as referrer when people save ZCHF and earn up to 25% of the interest, paid by the contract.

hero.title: Earn a share of the interest your savers collect.
hero.subtitle: The Frankencoin savings contract has referrals built in. Send people to save ZCHF with your link and receive up to 25% of the interest they earn, paid automatically on-chain.

cards.title: 1 · Share your link
cards.description: Your link opens the app's Earn page with your address and fee filled in.

cards.title: 2 · They save
cards.description: When the saver deposits, the contract records you as their referrer.

cards.title: 3 · You earn
cards.description: Each time their interest is collected, your share goes to your address. No invoices, no payouts to chase.

builder.title: Create your referral link
builder.feeHint: Up to 25%. A lower share is a better deal for your savers.

items.title: Savers stay in control
items.description: A saver can remove or change the referrer at any time.

items.title: Capped by the contract
items.description: The contract rejects any share above 25% of interest.

items.title: Public
items.description: Referrer balances are visible to everyone in the app's leaderboard.

items.title: Wallets and apps
items.description: Add savings in your interface and earn on every user who saves.

items.title: Communities
items.description: Groups and newsletters that help members save in francs.

items.title: Creators
items.description: Educators who explain on-chain savings to their audience.

note: Earnings depend on the savings rate, which governance can change, and on how long your savers keep their balance.
